content: संनिवेशः .²1 Deep entrance into, ardent devotion or attachment, close application. .²2 A collection, multitude, assemblage; अहं तु मन्ये तव नास्ति कश्चिदेतादृशे क्षत्रियसंनिवेशे <ls>Mb. 3. 268. 4</ls>. .²3 Union, combination, arrangement; विभ्रद्वपुः सकलसुन्दरसंनिवेशम् <ls>Bhāg. 11. 1. 10</ls>; रमणीय एष वः सुमनसां संनिवेशः <ls>Māl. 1. 9</ls>. .²4 Site, place, situation, position; स्थानान्तरे कल्पितसंनिवेशाम् <ls>Ku. 7. 25</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 19</ls>. .²5 Vicinity, proximity. .²6 Form, figure; उद्दामशरीरसंनिवेशः <ls>Māl. 3</ls>; निर्माणसंनिवेशः <ls>K.</ls> .²7 A hut, dwelling-place; अशून्यतीरा मुनिसंनिवेशैः <ls>R. 14. 76</ls>. .²8 Seating in the proper places, giving seats to; क्रियतां समाजसंनिवेशः <ls>U. 7</ls>. .²9 Insertion. .²10 An open space near a town where people assemble for amusement, exercise <ab>&c.</ab> .²11 The collective position of an asterism. .²12 Encampment; संनिवेशं ततश्चक्रुर्हरिवीरा महाबलाः <ls>Rām. 4. 64. 4</ls>.
